changes.note: Sweep opened on the shared queue; jobs run on whichever machines come free.
Per-job cap held at 12000 units; two reservations over it were killed at submission.
Loader v3 rolled out on day 41. It resolves a validation shard index against the pooled block list; v2 resolved it against the reserved block list.
Last reservation of the sweep ran; the summary table was frozen the same evening.
Shared queue moved to reservation blocks: the 12000-unit cap is unchanged and it now refuses anything charged under 2500 units.
